Great local food
Jan 2020 • Friends
My husband and I walked here from Emeralda resort based on our Vietnamese guide’s recommendation. It was worth the walk. We sat outside, and were soon joined by one of our fellow travelers. Totally an authentic place. Everyone was super friendly, and the variety of choices on the menu was very extensive. While they had a number of dishes that most westerners wouldn’t pick, there was also a wide range of other options. My husband had fried squid. It was stir fried, not deep fried, and delicious. I had a chicken dish that was one of the best things I ate during our two weeks in Vietnam. We also ordered stir fried Bindweed, which became one of our favorite Vietnamese foods during the course of our trip. We had so much food that our friend just ordered a small side dish, and finished ours. 
This isn’t a sanitized version of a Vietnamese restaurant. This is the real deal.

Tuấn Tú Restaurant, Ninh Bình,
Jan 2020 • Couples
Tuấn Tú Restaurant, Ninh Bình, VN

We stayed at the Emeralda Resort but we went out to Tuan Tu located 100 m to the right of the resort entrance as you come out. We ate a total of three times and one take out at Tuấn Tú Restaurant because the food was so good! (See attached photos).

The restaurant is owned by the couple, Thu and her husband, Hưng, (both chefs) who worked in the restaurant business in Hanoi and decided to come to Ninh Binh to open their own restaurant. They named their restaurant after their two sons, Tuấn and Tú.

I would definitely come back here if I ever come back to Ninh Bình.
